01 — About

Curious Builder

Three directions, one curiosity: building software, finding meaning in data, and learning how systems stay secure.

I’m Abdulmonim Farrag, a software developer and data analyst with a growing focus on cybersecurity. I enjoy understanding how systems work, turning messy information into useful insight, and building practical solutions that feel real.

My projects sit where code, data, and security meet. I learn by building, testing ideas, and going one layer deeper each time.
